reviewer: Codex assisted technical project review; no independent human or clinical review
rationale: The v39 SFT checkpoint is bound to the privacy-finalized v2.2 corpus, has complete resumable artifacts, changed finite LoRA tensors, and reproduced all 30 frozen generations with zero validation-loss delta after a fresh-process reload. A single bounded 20-step DPO experiment is admitted to measure preference optimization without claiming clinical improvement.
constraints: Policy and reference must start from the exact v39 SFT adapter.
The reference adapter must remain unchanged and the policy must change.
No held-out triage reserve record may be opened or used.
A completed DPO run must be reloaded and compared before any quality claim.
No continuation beyond 20 steps is automatic.
